title: MedAraBench: Large-Scale Arabic Medical Question Answering Dataset and Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking the zero-shot and few-shot performance of various proprietary and open-source Large Language Models (LLMs) on an Arabic medical multiple-choice question dataset to expose performance gaps, reasoning limitations, and the general underrepresentation of the Arabic language in clinical NLP capabilities.

Analyzing the distribution of correct answer choices (e.g., A, B, C, D, E) across the dataset splits using chi-square goodness-of-fit tests to detect and mitigate model bias toward specific answer positions or layout-based heuristics.
